blocks.text: Versatile form builder with 10,000+ templates and payment processing

Jotform has been in the form business longer than most competitors, and it shows in the breadth of its template library. With over 10,000 templates covering everything from event registration to medical intake forms, you rarely need to start from scratch.

The drag-and-drop builder strikes a good balance between simplicity and power. You can create a basic contact form in minutes, or build complex multi-page forms with conditional logic, payment processing, and digital signatures. The same tool scales from simple to sophisticated.

For teams that need to process payments through forms - event registrations, product orders, donations - Jotform supports Square, PayPal, Stripe, and other payment gateways natively. No third-party integration required.
Ready-made forms for virtually every industry and use case
Visual form builder with 100+ field types and widgets
Native support for Stripe, PayPal, Square, and more
Built-in approval chains for multi-step processes

Jotform's template library and payment integration make it the fastest path from need to live form for most business scenarios. If you need a form that collects payments, Jotform gets it done quickly.
Our team can integrate Jotform into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
